# Daniel Kmak

> Blockchain engineer building cross-chain bridges, token standards and developer tooling across EVM and Solana. In blockchain since 2017, fully remote since 2018.

## About

- Engineer since 2016, in blockchain since 2017.
- Most recently led an integrations team at a cross-chain protocol: owned technical quality, hired engineers and personally shipped the most critical partner integrations.
- Featured work: cross-chain token and governance bridging infrastructure for one of DeFi's longest-standing protocols, built on EVM and Solana.

## Expertise

- Smart contracts: Solidity, Foundry
- Solana: Rust, Anchor
- Cross-chain: bridges and messaging
- Developer tooling: TypeScript, Node.js
- Infrastructure: Kubernetes, AWS
- Leadership: teams and hiring
